capabilities: Archive remote media referenced in markdown to a content-addressed local cache
Redirect rendered img, video and audio sources to local or WebDAV copies at display time
Share the archive across devices via WebDAV servers with upload and retry
Scan the vault manually or on file modify to archive new remote URLs
Apply domain policies deciding which URLs to archive or skip
disambiguation: Not a web-page archiver; it caches only the image, video and audio files a note embeds, never the pages themselves.
extras: Prominently warns that attachment-cleanup plugins (oz-clear-unused-images, Local Images Plus) may delete the archive folder and cause vault wipes; desktop only; previously installed via BRAT while awaiting community review.
motivation: The author built it because quoted articles, tweets and research embed remote media whose hosts can vanish, breaking every embed in the vault.
problem: Remote media embedded in notes silently breaks when the original host disappears (deleted accounts, removed tweets, expired CDN URLs), leaving notes without their visual context.

relations.evidence: Archive Redirect is now part of Media One, as its Web image archive module

summary: Archives remote images, video and audio embedded in notes to a local content-addressed cache and serves them at render time to stop link rot.
